idea: Contact-graph mining across n: take the best layouts found for neighbouring counts (n−2..n+2) and extract recurring local motifs, such as a 2×2-into-1 merge, an L-corner or a frame. Re-apply every motif at every compatible position of the current layout, scoring each result with the compaction LP, so improvements found at one n propagate to the others within the run.
